itens.trecho: Interessante e positivo, apesar de ser demasiado lamechas. Este filme conta a história das vidas do Coronel Ludlow e dos seus três filhos (Alfred, Samuel e Tristan) numa casa na pradaria americana.

Similar to “A River Runs through It” but more heroic and melodramatic Near the close of the 19th Century, a disillusioned Army Colonel (Anthony Hopkins) sets up a ranch in remote western Montana with his Cree friend, One Stab (Gordon Tootoosis). He nurtures a family of a wife & three boys, plus his loyal personnel.
